offence_note: Sexual touching and invitation to sexual touching of stepdaughter child
sentence_quote: S.F.W. for a sexual purpose touched R.E.H., a person under the age of sixteen years with a part of his body contrary to section 151 of the Criminal Code to a sentence of incarceration for 6 years to be served in a federal institution.
note: Six years concurrent on counts 3 and 2; count 1 stayed.

offence_note: Break and enter of a dwelling house
sentence_quote: I hereby sentence you to a total period of imprisonment 24 months less 1 day.
systemic_quote: The content of the report puts Mr. Bernard's life and past conduct in an Aboriginal perspective. I conclude from this information that rehabilitation and restorative goals should still be considered as appropriate for this offender.
note: Credit 1.5:1 for custody since Sept 30, 2013, duration not stated.

offence_note: Home invasion robbery, unlawful confinement, masked face, possession for trafficking cocaine
sentence_quote: For the break and enter (robbery) the appropriate sentence is six years, unlawful confinement, four years concurrent. Mask, four years concurrent, and the CDSA, two years consecutive.
note: Six years plus two years consecutive; total after totality adjustment.

offence_note: Careless use and pointing of firearm, threatening
sentence_quote: was sentenced on June 28, 1999 in Vernon Provincial Court to nine months imprisonment to be followed by a period of 18 months probation

offence_note: Two first degree murders and two attempted murders with firearm
sentence_quote: On Count 1, the murder of Michael Lunn, I hereby sentence you to life imprisonment. There will be no eligibility for parole until the expiry of 25 years.
note: Concurrent life sentences; court recommends institution allowing family contact.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking, prohibited firearm and magazine possession
sentence_quote: I would allow the Crown's appeal to the extent of increasing the custodial sentence on Count 6 from two years less a day to 36 months.
note: Other counts concurrent; 36 months is global jail term; 10 year s.109 ban.

offence_note: Failing to remain at scene of accident causing bodily harm
sentence_quote: In relation to count 1 on the indictment you will receive a sentence of eight months as a conditional sentence to be served in the community.
note: Driving restricted as probation condition except for work; fear or panic accepted as mitigating.

offence_note: Manslaughter and indignity to human remains
sentence_quote: For Count 1, the manslaughter conviction, I sentence you to 4,015 days in custody less enhanced pretrial custody credit of 2,130 days, leaving a remaining sentence of 1,885 days to be served.
note: Dangerous offender designation with determinate sentence plus 10 year LTSO; joint submission.

offence_note: Manslaughter by striking man with truck during theft attempt
sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to 18 years in prison. After giving Duncan and Summers credit, he was ordered to serve an additional 14 years in custody.
